source.text: וַיַּמְלִיכוּ֩ יוֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אֶת־אֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֤וֹ הַקָּטֹן֙ תַּחְתָּ֔יו כִּ֤י כָל־הָרִאשֹׁנִים֙ הָרַ֣ג הַגְּד֔וּד הַבָּ֥א בָֽעַרְבִ֖ים לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־יְהוֹרָ֖ם מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And made king [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem Ahaziah his son the youngest in his place, for all the older [ones] had killed the band that came with the Arabs to the camp; and reigned Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah.

en.L: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place, for the raiding band that came with the Arabs to the camp had killed all the older [ones]. And Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
en.B: The people of Jerusalem made Ahaziah, Jehoram's youngest son, king in his place, because the band of raiders who came into the camp with the Arabs had killed every one of the older sons. So Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.
en.R: The people living in Jerusalem made Jehoram's youngest son Ahaziah king after him. Raiders had come into the camp along with the Arabs and killed all his older sons. So Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah.

es.L: Y los habitantes de Jerusalén hicieron rey en su lugar a Ocozías, su hijo menor, porque la banda que vino con los árabes al campamento había matado a todos los mayores. Y reinó Ocozías hijo de Jehoram, rey de Judá.
es.B: Los habitantes de Jerusalén proclamaron rey en su lugar a Ocozías, el hijo menor de Jehoram, porque la banda de saqueadores que había entrado en el campamento con los árabes había matado a todos los hijos mayores. Así comenzó a reinar Ocozías hijo de Jehoram, rey de Judá.
es.R: La gente que vivía en Jerusalén hizo rey a Ocozías, el hijo menor de Jehoram, para que lo sucediera. Unos saqueadores habían entrado en el campamento junto con los árabes y habían matado a todos sus hijos mayores. Así Ocozías hijo de Jehoram llegó a ser rey de Judá.

fr.L: Et les habitants de Jérusalem firent roi à sa place Achazia, son plus jeune fils, car la bande qui était venue au camp avec les Arabes avait tué tous les aînés. Et Achazia fils de Yehoram, roi de Juda, régna.
fr.B: Les habitants de Jérusalem firent roi à sa place Achazia, le plus jeune fils de Yehoram, car la bande de pillards venue au camp avec les Arabes avait tué tous les fils plus âgés. Ainsi Achazia, fils de Yehoram, roi de Juda, commença à régner.
fr.R: Les habitants de Jérusalem ont fait roi Achazia, le plus jeune fils de Yehoram, pour le remplacer. En effet, des pillards étaient venus dans le camp avec les Arabes, et ils avaient tué tous ses fils plus âgés. C’est ainsi qu’Achazia, fils de Yehoram, est devenu roi de Juda.

sw.L: Nao wakaaji wa Yerusalemu wakamtawaza Ahazia mwanawe mdogo kuwa mfalme mahali pake, kwa maana kikosi cha wavamizi kilichokuja pamoja na Waarabu kambini kilikuwa kimewaua wote waliokuwa wakubwa. Naye Ahazia mwana wa Yehoramu mfalme wa Yuda akatawala.
sw.B: Watu wa Yerusalemu walimtawaza Ahazia, mwana mdogo wa Yehoramu, kuwa mfalme mahali pake, kwa sababu kikosi cha wavamizi kilichoingia kambini pamoja na Waarabu kilikuwa kimewaua wanawe wote wakubwa. Hivyo Ahazia mwana wa Yehoramu mfalme wa Yuda akaanza kutawala.
sw.R: Watu walioishi Yerusalemu walimfanya Ahazia, mwana mdogo wa Yehoramu, kuwa mfalme baada yake. Wavamizi walikuwa wameingia kambini pamoja na Waarabu, wakawaua wanawe wote wakubwa. Basi Ahazia mwana wa Yehoramu akawa mfalme wa Yuda.

vi.L: Dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem lập A-cha-xia, con trai út của vua, lên làm vua thay vua, vì toán quân cướp đi cùng người A-rập vào trại quân đã giết hết những [người con] lớn. Vậy A-cha-xia con trai Giê-hô-ram vua Giu-đa trị vì.
vi.B: Dân Giê-ru-sa-lem lập A-cha-xia, con trai út của Giê-hô-ram, lên làm vua thay cha, vì toán quân cướp cùng người A-rập vào trại quân đã giết hết các con trai lớn. Vậy A-cha-xia con trai Giê-hô-ram vua Giu-đa bắt đầu trị vì.
vi.R: Dân sống tại Giê-ru-sa-lem lập A-cha-xia, con trai út của Giê-hô-ram, lên làm vua thay cha. Quân cướp đã cùng người A-rập vào trại quân và giết hết các con trai lớn của vua. Vậy A-cha-xia con trai Giê-hô-ram lên làm vua Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 예루살렘 주민들이 그의 막내아들 아하시야를 그를 대신하여 왕으로 세웠다. 아랍 사람들과 함께 진영에 온 약탈대가 형들을 모두 죽였기 때문이다. 그리고 유다 왕 여호람의 아들 아하시야가 다스렸다.
ko.B: 예루살렘 주민들은 여호람의 막내아들 아하시야를 그의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세웠다. 아랍 사람들과 함께 진영에 쳐들어온 약탈대가 그의 형들을 모두 죽였기 때문이다. 그리하여 유다 왕 여호람의 아들 아하시야가 다스리기 시작했다.
ko.R: 예루살렘에 사는 사람들은 여호람의 막내아들 아하시야를 그의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세웠다. 전에 약탈자들이 아랍 사람들과 함께 진영에 쳐들어와서 그의 형들을 모두 죽였기 때문이다. 그래서 여호람의 아들 아하시야가 유다의 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E os habitantes de Jerusalém fizeram Acazias, o seu filho mais novo, rei em seu lugar, porque o bando de saqueadores que tinha vindo com os árabes ao acampamento havia matado todos os mais velhos. E Acazias, filho de Jorão, rei de Judá, reinou.
pt.B: Os habitantes de Jerusalém fizeram Acazias, o filho mais novo de Jorão, rei em seu lugar, porque o bando de saqueadores que tinha entrado no acampamento com os árabes havia matado todos os filhos mais velhos. Assim Acazias, filho de Jorão, rei de Judá, começou a reinar.
pt.R: O povo de Jerusalém fez de Acazias, o filho mais novo de Jorão, o rei depois dele. Um bando de saqueadores tinha entrado no acampamento junto com os árabes e matado todos os filhos mais velhos de Jorão. Assim Acazias, filho de Jorão, se tornou rei de Judá.

decisions.choice: the inhabitants of Jerusalem made him king: the people of the capital put him on the throne
decisions.reason: Chronicles says who made Ahaziah king: the people of Jerusalem. Elsewhere the people of Judah, or "the people of the land", make a king when the line is in danger (26:1; 33:25; 36:1). With the older sons dead, the city acted to crown the one son left.

decisions.choice: the band that came with the Arabs: the raid of 21:16-17
decisions.reason: 21:16-17 tells how Philistines and Arabs invaded Judah and carried off King Jehoram's sons and wives, leaving only his youngest son, there called Jehoahaz. Jehoahaz and Ahaziah are two forms of one name, made of the same two parts in reverse order ("Yahweh has taken hold").

decisions.choice: to the camp: the camp of Judah's king or army
alternatives: came with the Arabs against the camp
decisions.reason: The raiders came into the camp, most likely the royal or army camp where the king's sons were. The phrase may also mean that the band came along with the Arabs against the camp. Either way the sense is that the older sons died in that raid.

decisions.choice: the accession: told more fully than in 2 Kings 8:24-25
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 8:24 says only that Ahaziah his son reigned in his place, and 8:25 dates it to the twelfth year of Joram of Israel. Chronicles leaves out the date and says instead how the youngest son came to the throne.

decisions.choice: Jehoram's; sons (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "His" refers to Jehoram, whose death closes chapter 21; Balanced and Readable name him and say that the older ones were sons. Literal brackets "ones".

decisions.choice: raiding band (Literal); band of raiders (Balanced); raiders (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word names a band of armed men who make raids, not a regular army.

decisions.choice: "la banda" (L); "la banda de saqueadores" (B); "unos saqueadores" (R)
decisions.reason: The word names armed raiders, not a regular army, as the English decision says.

decisions.choice: "la bande" (Literal); "la bande de pillards" (Balanced); "des pillards" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word names armed raiders, not a regular army; French "bande" says this.

decisions.choice: kikosi cha wavamizi (L, B); wavamizi (R)
decisions.reason: The word names a band of raiders, not a regular army; "kikosi cha wavamizi" says so.

decisions.choice: "약탈대" (Literal, Balanced), "약탈자들" (Readable) for the raiding band
decisions.reason: The word names an armed band that raids, not a regular army (r-en-2).

decisions.choice: Acazias, filho de Jorão, rei de Judá; reinou (L), começou a reinar (B), se tornou rei (R)
decisions.reason: The names and the accession formula keep the Portuguese of 2 Kings 8:24-25, which this verse retells (m4): "Acazias", and "Jorão" for his father, the one form 2 Kings 1:17 sets in Portuguese for both kings of that name. Chapters 22-25 follow the Portuguese of 2 Kings 8-14 level by level wherever Chronicles repeats it and change only what Chronicles changes; each parallel is named in a decision.

decisions.choice: o bando de saqueadores (L, B); um bando de saqueadores (R)
decisions.reason: "Bando" is a group of armed men who make raids (r-en-2), and "saqueadores" says what they did; "tropa" or "exército" would make them a regular army. Readable keeps the phrase, since "saqueadores" alone reads as thieves.

source.text: בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִ֨ים וּשְׁתַּ֤יִם שָׁנָה֙ אֲחַזְיָ֣הוּ בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וְשָׁנָ֣ה אַחַ֔ת מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ בַּת־עָמְרִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: A son of forty and two year[s was] Ahaziah when he became king, and year one he reigned in Jerusalem; and [the] name of his mother [was] Athaliah daughter of Omri.

en.L: Ahaziah [was] a son of forty-two years when he became king, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And the name of his mother [was] Athaliah daughter of Omri.
en.B: Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Athaliah, the granddaughter of Omri.
en.R: Ahaziah became king at the age of forty-two, and he ruled in Jerusalem for one year. His mother was Athaliah, the granddaughter of Omri.

es.L: Hijo de cuarenta y dos años [era] Ocozías cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó un año en Jerusalén. Y el nombre de su madre [era] Atalía hija de Omri.
es.B: Ocozías tenía cuarenta y dos años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó un año en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Atalía, nieta de Omri.
es.R: Ocozías llegó a ser rey a los cuarenta y dos años, y gobernó en Jerusalén durante un año. Su madre se llamaba Atalía, y era nieta de Omri.

fr.L: Achazia [était] fils de quarante-deux ans quand il devint roi, et il régna un an à Jérusalem. Et le nom de sa mère [était] Athalie, fille d’Omri.
fr.B: Achazia avait quarante-deux ans quand il devint roi, et il régna un an à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Athalie ; elle était la petite-fille d’Omri.
fr.R: Achazia avait quarante-deux ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné à Jérusalem pendant un an. Sa mère s’appelait Athalie ; c’était la petite-fille d’Omri.

sw.L: Ahazia [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka arobaini na miwili alipoanza kutawala, akatawala mwaka mmoja huko Yerusalemu. Na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Athalia binti Omri.
sw.B: Ahazia alikuwa na umri wa miaka arobaini na miwili alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala mwaka mmoja huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Athalia, mjukuu wa Omri.
sw.R: Ahazia alianza kutawala akiwa na umri wa miaka arobaini na miwili, naye akatawala Yerusalemu kwa mwaka mmoja. Mama yake aliitwa Athalia, mjukuu wa Omri.

vi.L: A-cha-xia [được] bốn mươi hai tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì một năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là A-tha-li, con gái Ôm-ri.
vi.B: A-cha-xia được bốn mươi hai tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì một năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là A-tha-li, cháu gái Ôm-ri.
vi.R: A-cha-xia lên ngôi lúc bốn mươi hai tuổi và cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem một năm. Mẹ vua là A-tha-li, cháu gái Ôm-ri.

ko.L: 아하시야가 왕이 되었을 때에 42세였고, 예루살렘에서 1년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 오므리의 딸 아달랴였다.
ko.B: 아하시야는 42세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 1년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 아달랴였고, 오므리의 손녀였다.
ko.R: 아하시야는 42세에 왕이 되었고, 예루살렘에서 1년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니는 아달랴였는데, 오므리의 손녀였다.

pt.L: Acazias [tinha] quarenta e dois anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou um ano em Jerusalém. E o nome da sua mãe [era] Atalia, filha de Onri.
pt.B: Acazias tinha quarenta e dois anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou um ano em Jerusalém. A sua mãe se chamava Atalia, neta de Onri.
pt.R: Acazias tinha quarenta e dois anos quando se tornou rei, e governou um ano em Jerusalém. A mãe de Acazias se chamava Atalia, neta de Onri.

decisions.choice: forty-two years old: the Hebrew text of Chronicles; 2 Kings 8:26 has twenty-two
decisions.reason: His father Jehoram became king at thirty-two and reigned eight years (21:5, 20), so he died at forty; a son of forty-two is not possible. 2 Kings 8:26 gives twenty-two, and some ancient Greek and Syriac translations of Chronicles have twenty-two or twenty. The number here most likely arose in copying. The translation keeps the Hebrew text and gives the other number in a note.

decisions.choice: daughter of Omri: Omri's granddaughter
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 8:26: "daughter" can mean any female descendant. Athaliah was Ahab's daughter (21:6) and so Omri's granddaughter. Omri is named as the founder of the royal house of Israel she belonged to.

decisions.choice: the same words as 2 Kings 8:26, with two differences
decisions.reason: Chronicles repeats 2 Kings 8:26 except for the age (m1) and the title: Kings calls Omri "king of Israel", Chronicles gives his name alone. As there, the formula names the king's mother, the queen mother, who will seize the throne when her son dies (verse 10).

decisions.choice: daughter (Literal); granddaughter (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 8:26: Literal keeps the Hebrew word; Balanced and Readable say what it means here (m2).

decisions.choice: "hija" (L); "nieta" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Spanish 2 Kings 8:26: Literal keeps the Hebrew word; Balanced and Readable say what it means here (m2). The rest keeps the Kings wording, with the age the Hebrew of Chronicles gives (m1).

decisions.choice: the wording of French 2 Kings 8:26, with "quarante-deux" and without "roi d'Israël"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of Chronicles differs only there (m1, m3); "petite-fille" at Balanced and Readable as in Kings.

decisions.choice: the Swahili of 2 Kings 8:26
decisions.reason: Verses 2-6 and 10-12 repeat the Swahili of 2 Kings 8:26-29 and 11:1-3 at each level, changing only the age and what else the Chronicles Hebrew changes.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 8:26 with "bốn mươi hai"; "con gái" (L), "cháu gái" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Vietnamese Kings wording is reused, changing only the age, as the Hebrew of Chronicles does (m1).

decisions.choice: The wording of 2 Kings 8:26 with the Hebrew of Chronicles: "42세" and no "이스라엘 왕"
decisions.reason: The text follows the Hebrew of Chronicles, as the English does; the meaning decision (m1) gives the problem and the reading of Kings. Ages in figures at every level.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 8:26 in Portuguese, with "quarenta e dois" and without "rei de Israel"
decisions.reason: The accession formula repeats 2 Kings 8:26 in Portuguese level by level, including "filha" (L) and "neta" (B, R) for Omri's granddaughter (m2). Only what Chronicles changes is changed (m3): the age, "quarenta e dois", as the Hebrew of Chronicles has it (m1), and Omri named without his title.

source.text: גַּם־ה֣וּא הָלַ֔ךְ בְּדַרְכֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב כִּ֥י אִמּ֛וֹ הָיְתָ֥ה יֽוֹעַצְתּ֖וֹ לְהַרְשִֽׁיעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Also he walked in [the] ways of [the] house of Ahab, for his mother was his counselor to act wickedly.

en.L: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother was his counselor to act wickedly.
en.B: He too walked in the ways of the house of Ahab, because his mother advised him to act wickedly.
en.R: He also lived the way Ahab's family lived, because his mother advised him to do wicked things.

es.L: También él anduvo en los caminos de la casa de Acab, porque su madre era su consejera para obrar impíamente.
es.B: También él siguió los caminos de la casa de Acab, porque su madre lo aconsejaba a obrar con maldad.
es.R: También él vivió como vivía la familia de Acab, porque su madre le aconsejaba que hiciera lo malo.

fr.L: Lui aussi marcha dans les voies de la maison d’Achab, car sa mère était sa conseillère pour agir méchamment.
fr.B: Lui aussi suivit les voies de la maison d’Achab, car sa mère le conseillait pour qu’il fasse le mal.
fr.R: Lui aussi a vécu comme la famille d’Achab, parce que sa mère lui conseillait de faire le mal.

sw.L: Yeye pia akaenda katika njia za nyumba ya Ahabu, kwa maana mama yake alikuwa mshauri wake wa kutenda maovu.
sw.B: Yeye naye alifuata njia za nyumba ya Ahabu, kwa sababu mama yake alimshauri atende maovu.
sw.R: Yeye pia aliishi kama jamaa ya Ahabu walivyoishi, kwa sababu mama yake alimshauri afanye mambo maovu.

vi.L: Vua cũng đi trong các đường lối của nhà A-háp, vì mẹ vua là người khuyên bảo vua làm điều gian ác.
vi.B: Vua cũng đi theo đường lối của nhà A-háp, vì mẹ vua khuyên vua làm điều gian ác.
vi.R: Vua cũng sống theo cách gia đình A-háp sống, vì mẹ vua xúi vua làm những điều gian ác.

ko.L: 그도 아합의 집의 길들로 걸었다. 그의 어머니가 악하게 행하도록 그에게 조언하는 자였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그도 아합 집안의 길들을 따라갔다. 그의 어머니가 그에게 악을 행하도록 조언했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그도 아합의 집안이 살던 방식대로 살았다. 그의 어머니가 그에게 악한 일을 하라고 부추겼기 때문이다.

pt.L: Também ele andou nos caminhos da casa de Acabe, porque a sua mãe era a sua conselheira para agir com perversidade.
pt.B: Ele também andou nos caminhos da casa de Acabe, porque a sua mãe o aconselhava a agir com perversidade.
pt.R: Ele também viveu como a família de Acabe vivia, porque a sua mãe o aconselhava a praticar o mal.

decisions.choice: he also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: like his father
decisions.reason: "Also" links Ahaziah to his father Jehoram, who walked in the way of the kings of Israel because Ahab's daughter was his wife (21:6). 2 Kings 8:27 has "the way"; Chronicles has "the ways" and adds the reason: his mother's counsel.

decisions.choice: his mother was his counselor: the queen mother's power at court
decisions.reason: Athaliah, of Ahab's house, guided her young son's rule. Chronicles traces his evil to her, and verse 4 adds the rest of Ahab's family.

decisions.choice: to act wickedly: she advised him toward wickedness
decisions.reason: The verb form means to act wickedly, as of Ahaziah king of Israel in 20:35. The phrase gives the aim or the result of her counsel: he did what was wicked.

decisions.choice: lived the way Ahab's family lived (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 8:27: "walked in the ways" means how he lived and ruled; "house" means family.

decisions.choice: andou nos caminhos da casa de Acabe (L, B); viveu como a família de Acabe vivia (R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 8:27 in Portuguese, with the plural "caminhos" where Chronicles has "the ways" for Kings' "the way" (m1); Readable keeps Kings' wording unchanged, since it does not show the number.

source.text: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כְּבֵ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב כִּי־הֵ֜מָּה הָֽיוּ־ל֣וֹ יֽוֹעֲצִ֗ים אַחֲרֵ֛י מ֥וֹת אָבִ֖יו לְמַשְׁחִ֥ית לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh like [the] house of Ahab, for they were to him counselors after [the] death of his father, to destruction to him.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, like the house of Ahab, for they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as the house of Ahab had done, for after his father's death they were his counselors, to his destruction.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil, just as Ahab's family did. After his father died, they became his advisers, and their advice destroyed him.

es.L: E hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como la casa de Acab, porque ellos fueron sus consejeros después de la muerte de su padre, para su ruina.
es.B: Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como había hecho la casa de Acab, porque después de la muerte de su padre ellos fueron sus consejeros, para su ruina.
es.R: Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba, igual que la familia de Acab. Después de que murió su padre, ellos fueron sus consejeros, y sus consejos lo llevaron a la ruina.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme la maison d’Achab, car ils furent ses conseillers après la mort de son père, pour sa perte.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, comme l’avait fait la maison d’Achab, car après la mort de son père ce furent eux ses conseillers, pour sa perte.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais, comme la famille d’Achab. Après la mort de son père, ce sont eux qui sont devenus ses conseillers, et leurs conseils l’ont mené à sa perte.

sw.L: Akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama nyumba ya Ahabu, kwa maana wao walikuwa washauri wake baada ya kifo cha baba yake, kwa maangamizi yake.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama nyumba ya Ahabu ilivyofanya, kwa sababu baada ya kifo cha baba yake wao walikuwa washauri wake, hata akaangamia.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya, kama jamaa ya Ahabu walivyofanya. Baba yake alipokufa, wao wakawa washauri wake, na ushauri wao ukamwangamiza.

vi.L: Vua làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như nhà A-háp, vì sau khi cha vua qua đời, họ là những người khuyên bảo vua, để vua bị hủy diệt.
vi.B: Vua làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như nhà A-háp đã làm, vì sau khi cha vua qua đời, họ trở thành những người khuyên bảo vua, khiến vua bị hủy diệt.
vi.R: Vua làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác, giống như gia đình A-háp. Sau khi cha vua qua đời, họ trở thành người cố vấn cho vua, và lời khuyên của họ đã hủy hoại vua.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 아합의 집처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했다. 그의 아버지가 죽은 뒤에 그들이 그에게 조언하는 자들이 되어, 그를 멸망에 [이르게 했기] 때문이다.
ko.B: 그는 아합의 집안처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다. 그의 아버지가 죽은 뒤에 그들이 그의 조언자가 되어, 그를 망하게 했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그는 아합의 집안처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다. 그의 아버지가 죽은 뒤에 아합의 집안사람들이 그의 조언자가 되었는데, 그들의 조언이 그를 망하게 했다.

pt.L: E fez o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como a casa de Acabe, porque eles foram os seus conselheiros depois da morte do seu pai, para a sua destruição.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como a casa de Acabe tinha feito, porque, depois da morte do seu pai, eles foram os seus conselheiros, para a sua ruína.
pt.R: Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau, assim como a família de Acabe. Depois que o seu pai morreu, eles passaram a ser os seus conselheiros, e os conselhos deles o destruíram.

decisions.choice: the verdict of 2 Kings 8:27, with a different reason
decisions.reason: The first half repeats 2 Kings 8:27. Kings gives the reason that Ahaziah was related by marriage to the house of Ahab; Chronicles says instead that Ahab's family were his counselors once his father had died.

decisions.choice: they: members of the house of Ahab
decisions.reason: The plural "they" looks back to "the house of Ahab": Ahab's relatives at Ahaziah's court, together with his mother (verse 3).

decisions.choice: to his destruction: the counsel led to his ruin
decisions.reason: The word means destruction or ruin. The counsel that took him to Ramoth-gilead and Jezreel ended in his death (verses 5-9). Chronicles shows bad counsel ruining a king, as with Rehoboam (10:8-15).

decisions.choice: the verdict formula
decisions.reason: As throughout Kings and Chronicles: "did the evil in [the] eyes of" / "did what was evil in the sight of" / "did what the LORD said was evil".

decisions.choice: their advice destroyed him (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable turns "to his destruction" into a clause and names the advice as what led to it (m3).

decisions.choice: fez o mal aos olhos do SENHOR (L); fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR (B); fez o que o SENHOR considerava mau (R)
decisions.reason: The verdict keeps the words of 2 Kings 8:27 in Portuguese at each level (m1); the reason that follows is Chronicles' own and is drafted from the Hebrew. "Ruína" at Balanced is the plain word for what the counsel brought on him (m3).

source.text: גַּ֣ם בַּעֲצָתָם֮ הָלַךְ֒ וַיֵּלֶךְ֩ אֶת־יְהוֹרָ֨ם בֶּן־אַחְאָ֜ב מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה עַל־חֲזָאֵ֥ל מֶֽלֶךְ־אֲרָ֖ם בְּרָמ֣וֹת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַיַּכּ֥וּ הָֽרַמִּ֖ים אֶת־יוֹרָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Also in their counsel he walked, and he went with Jehoram son of Ahab king of Israel to the war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth-gilead; and struck the Arameans Joram.

en.L: He also walked in their counsel, and he went with Jehoram son of Ahab king of Israel to the war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth-gilead, and the Arameans struck Joram.
en.B: He also followed their counsel and went with Jehoram son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth-gilead, and Joram was wounded by the Arameans.
en.R: Following their advice, Ahaziah went with Jehoram son of Ahab, the king of Israel, to fight against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth-gilead. There the Arameans wounded Joram.

es.L: También anduvo en el consejo de ellos, y fue con Jehoram hijo de Acab, rey de Israel, a la guerra contra Hazael, rey de Aram, en Ramot de Galaad; y los arameos hirieron a Joram.
es.B: También siguió el consejo de ellos y fue con Jehoram hijo de Acab, rey de Israel, a la guerra contra Hazael, rey de Aram, en Ramot de Galaad, y los arameos hirieron a Joram.
es.R: Siguiendo sus consejos, Ocozías fue con Jehoram hijo de Acab, el rey de Israel, a pelear contra Hazael, rey de Aram, en Ramot de Galaad. Allí los arameos hirieron a Joram.

fr.L: Il marcha aussi selon leur conseil, et il alla avec Yehoram fils d’Achab, roi d’Israël, à la guerre contre Hazaël, roi d’Aram, à Ramoth de Galaad ; et les Araméens frappèrent Joram.
fr.B: Il suivit aussi leur conseil et partit avec Yehoram, fils d’Achab, roi d’Israël, faire la guerre à Hazaël, roi d’Aram, à Ramoth de Galaad, et Joram fut blessé par les Araméens.
fr.R: Suivant leurs conseils, Achazia est allé avec Yehoram, fils d’Achab, roi d’Israël, combattre Hazaël, roi d’Aram, à Ramoth de Galaad. Là, les Araméens ont blessé Joram.

sw.L: Pia akaenda katika shauri lao, akaenda pamoja na Yehoramu mwana wa Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli vitani kupigana na Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu huko Ramoth-gileadi, nao Waaramu wakampiga Yoramu.
sw.B: Alifuata pia shauri lao, akaenda pamoja na Yehoramu mwana wa Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli vitani kupigana na Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu huko Ramoth-gileadi, naye Yoramu akajeruhiwa na Waaramu.
sw.R: Kwa kufuata shauri lao, Ahazia alikwenda pamoja na Yehoramu mwana wa Ahabu, mfalme wa Israeli, kupigana na Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu huko Ramoth-gileadi. Huko Waaramu wakamjeruhi Yoramu.

vi.L: Vua cũng đi theo lời khuyên của họ, và đi với Giê-hô-ram con trai A-háp vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đánh Ha-xa-ên vua A-ram tại Ra-mốt ở Ga-la-át; và quân A-ram đánh Giô-ram bị thương.
vi.B: Vua cũng nghe theo lời khuyên của họ mà cùng Giê-hô-ram con trai A-háp vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đi đánh Ha-xa-ên vua A-ram tại Ra-mốt ở Ga-la-át, và Giô-ram bị quân A-ram đánh bị thương.
vi.R: Nghe theo lời khuyên của họ, A-cha-xia đi với Giê-hô-ram con trai A-háp, vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, để đánh Ha-xa-ên vua A-ram tại Ra-mốt ở Ga-la-át. Tại đó quân A-ram làm cho Giô-ram bị thương.

ko.L: 그도 그들의 조언대로 걸었고, 이스라엘 왕 아합의 아들 여호람과 함께 길르앗 라못으로 아람 왕 하사엘과 싸우러 갔다. 그리고 아람 사람들이 요람을 쳤다.
ko.B: 그는 또 그들의 조언을 따라, 이스라엘 왕 아합의 아들 여호람과 함께 길르앗 라못으로 가서 아람 왕 하사엘과 싸웠는데, 요람이 아람 사람들에게 부상을 당했다.
ko.R: 아하시야는 그들의 조언을 따라, 이스라엘 왕인 아합의 아들 여호람과 함께 길르앗 라못으로 가서 아람 왕 하사엘과 싸웠다. 그곳에서 아람 사람들이 요람에게 부상을 입혔다.

pt.L: Também no conselho deles ele andou, e foi com Jorão, filho de Acabe, rei de Israel, à guerra contra Hazael, rei de Arã, em Ramote-Gileade; e os arameus feriram Jorão.
pt.B: Ele também seguiu o conselho deles e foi com Jorão, filho de Acabe, rei de Israel, à guerra contra Hazael, rei dos arameus, em Ramote-Gileade, e Jorão foi ferido pelos arameus.
pt.R: Seguindo o conselho deles, Acazias foi com Jorão, filho de Acabe, o rei de Israel, lutar contra Hazael, rei dos arameus, em Ramote-Gileade. Ali os arameus feriram Jorão.

decisions.choice: the same account as 2 Kings 8:28, with "he also walked in their counsel" added
decisions.reason: Chronicles repeats 2 Kings 8:28 and adds that Ahaziah went to war on the advice of Ahab's family (verse 4), so that the campaign itself is part of his ruin. Kings calls Ahab's son Joram here; Chronicles calls him Jehoram and then Joram.

decisions.choice: Jehoram son of Ahab, also called Joram: the king of Israel, not Ahaziah's father
decisions.reason: Jehoram and Joram are a longer and a shorter form of one name. This is Ahab's son, king of Israel, Ahaziah's uncle; Ahaziah's father Jehoram of Judah had the same name (verse 1).

decisions.choice: Ramoth-gilead: where Ahab fell
decisions.reason: Ahab had gone to war at Ramoth-gilead with Jehoshaphat of Judah and been killed there (18:2-34). Now Ahab's son and Jehoshaphat's grandson fight there together against Aram's new king.

decisions.choice: struck: wounded
decisions.reason: The verb means to strike; verse 6 shows that Joram was wounded, not killed.

decisions.choice: Jehoram ... Joram: each form as the Hebrew has it
decisions.reason: As in Kings, the name keeps the form each place uses; the meaning decision m2 says they are one man.

decisions.choice: Ahaziah; the king of Israel (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable names Ahaziah and sets off Jehoram's title, since two kings called Jehoram appear in this chapter.

decisions.choice: "Jehoram ... Joram"
decisions.reason: Each form of the king's name as the Hebrew has it, as in Kings; the meaning decision says they are one man (m2). The rest keeps the Spanish of 2 Kings 8:28.

decisions.choice: "Yehoram ... Joram"
decisions.reason: French keeps each form the Hebrew uses, as the Kings terms note; the rest follows French 2 Kings 8:28.

decisions.choice: "Giê-hô-ram" and "Giô-ram" as the Hebrew has them; the rest as 2 Kings 8:28
decisions.reason: As the terms note: a king with two names keeps the form each verse uses; the Vietnamese of 2 Kings 8:28 is reused (m1).

decisions.choice: "여호람" and "요람" as the verse has them, in the wording of 2 Kings 8:28
decisions.reason: Each verse keeps its own form of the name (terms note); m2 says they are one man.

decisions.choice: Jorão (for both "Jehoram" and "Joram")
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 8:28 in Portuguese, with Chronicles' added clause about counsel (m1) and the title "rei de Israel" placed as the Hebrew places it. The English keeps the two spellings of the name, Jehoram and Joram (r-en-1); Portuguese writes "Jorão" for both, as 2 Kings 1:17 sets it for Kings, so that one man does not look like two (m2).

source.text: וַיָּ֜שָׁב לְהִתְרַפֵּ֣א בְיִזְרְעֶ֗אל כִּ֤י הַמַּכִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכֻּ֣הוּ בָֽרָמָ֔ה בְּהִלָּ֣חֲמ֔וֹ אֶת־חֲזָהאֵ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וַעֲזַרְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־יְהוֹרָ֜ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה יָרַ֡ד לִרְא֞וֹת אֶת־יְהוֹרָ֧ם בֶּן־אַחְאָ֛ב בְּיִזְרְעֶ֖אל כִּי־חֹלֶ֥ה הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel, for the wounds that they struck him at Ramah when he fought with Hazael king of Aram; and Azariah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram son of Ahab in Jezreel, for sick [was] he.

en.L: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel, because of the wounds that they had struck him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Aram. And Azariah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he [was] sick.
en.B: He went back to Jezreel to recover from the wounds they had given him at Ramah, in his battle with Hazael king of Aram. Then Azariah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was wounded.
en.R: Joram went back to the town of Jezreel to recover from the wounds the Arameans had given him at Ramah, when he was fighting against Hazael king of Aram. Then Azariah son of Jehoram, the king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram son of Ahab there, because Jehoram was hurt. (Azariah is another form of the name Ahaziah.)

es.L: Y volvió para curarse en Jezreel de las heridas que le habían hecho en Ramá, cuando peleó contra Hazael, rey de Aram. Y Azarías hijo de Jehoram, rey de Judá, descendió a ver a Jehoram hijo de Acab en Jezreel, porque estaba enfermo.
es.B: Volvió a Jezreel para recuperarse de las heridas que le habían causado en Ramá, en su batalla contra Hazael, rey de Aram. Entonces Azarías hijo de Jehoram, rey de Judá, bajó a ver a Jehoram hijo de Acab en Jezreel, porque estaba herido.
es.R: Joram volvió a la ciudad de Jezreel para recuperarse de las heridas que los arameos le habían causado en Ramá, cuando peleaba contra Hazael, rey de Aram. Entonces Azarías hijo de Jehoram, el rey de Judá, fue a visitar allí a Jehoram hijo de Acab, porque Jehoram estaba herido. (Azarías es otra forma del nombre Ocozías).

fr.L: Et il revint se faire soigner à Jizreël des blessures qu’on lui avait faites à Rama, quand il combattit contre Hazaël, roi d’Aram. Et Azaria fils de Yehoram, roi de Juda, descendit voir Yehoram fils d’Achab à Jizreël, car il [était] malade.
fr.B: Il revint à Jizreël pour se remettre des blessures qu’on lui avait faites à Rama, dans sa bataille contre Hazaël, roi d’Aram. Azaria, fils de Yehoram, roi de Juda, descendit alors voir Yehoram, fils d’Achab, à Jizreël, parce qu’il était blessé.
fr.R: Joram est retourné dans la ville de Jizreël pour se remettre des blessures que les Araméens lui avaient faites à Rama, quand il combattait contre Hazaël, roi d’Aram. Azaria, fils de Yehoram, roi de Juda, est alors allé voir Yehoram, fils d’Achab, là-bas, parce que Yehoram était blessé. (Azaria est une autre forme du nom Achazia.)

sw.L: Akarudi ili aponywe huko Yezreeli majeraha ambayo walimpiga huko Rama, alipopigana na Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu. Naye Azaria mwana wa Yehoramu mfalme wa Yuda akashuka kumwona Yehoramu mwana wa Ahabu huko Yezreeli, kwa sababu [alikuwa] mgonjwa.
sw.B: Alirudi Yezreeli kuuguza majeraha ambayo walimtia huko Rama, katika vita vyake na Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu. Kisha Azaria mwana wa Yehoramu mfalme wa Yuda akashuka kumwona Yehoramu mwana wa Ahabu huko Yezreeli, kwa sababu alikuwa amejeruhiwa.
sw.R: Yoramu alirudi katika mji wa Yezreeli ili apone majeraha ambayo Waaramu walimtia huko Rama, alipokuwa akipigana na Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu. Kisha Azaria mwana wa Yehoramu, mfalme wa Yuda, akaenda kumwona Yehoramu mwana wa Ahabu huko, kwa sababu Yehoramu alikuwa ameumia. (Azaria ni namna nyingine ya jina Ahazia.)

vi.L: Vua trở về Gít-rê-ên để chữa những vết thương mà họ đã gây ra cho vua tại Ra-ma, khi vua giao chiến với Ha-xa-ên vua A-ram. A-xa-ria con trai Giê-hô-ram vua Giu-đa đi xuống Gít-rê-ên thăm Giê-hô-ram con trai A-háp, vì vua ấy bị bệnh.
vi.B: Vua trở về Gít-rê-ên để dưỡng thương, vì họ đã làm vua bị thương tại Ra-ma, khi vua giao chiến với Ha-xa-ên vua A-ram. Bấy giờ A-xa-ria con trai Giê-hô-ram vua Giu-đa đi xuống Gít-rê-ên thăm Giê-hô-ram con trai A-háp, vì vua ấy bị thương.
vi.R: Giô-ram trở về thành Gít-rê-ên để dưỡng thương. Quân A-ram đã làm vua bị thương tại Ra-ma, khi vua đánh nhau với Ha-xa-ên vua A-ram. Bấy giờ A-xa-ria con trai Giê-hô-ram, vua Giu-đa, đi xuống đó thăm Giê-hô-ram con trai A-háp, vì Giê-hô-ram bị thương. (A-xa-ria là một dạng khác của tên A-cha-xia.)

ko.L: 그리고 그가 아람 왕 하사엘과 싸울 때에 라마에서 그들이 그를 친 상처 때문에, 이스르엘에서 치료를 받으려고 돌아왔다. 그리고 유다 왕 여호람의 아들 아사랴가 아합의 아들 여호람을 보러 이스르엘로 내려갔다. 그가 병들었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그는 아람 왕 하사엘과 싸울 때에 라마에서 그들에게 입은 상처를 치료하려고 이스르엘로 돌아왔다. 유다 왕 여호람의 아들 아사랴는 아합의 아들 여호람이 부상을 입었으므로, 그를 보러 이스르엘로 내려갔다.
ko.R: 요람은 아람 왕 하사엘과 싸우다가 라마에서 아람 사람들에게 입은 상처를 치료하려고 이스르엘 성으로 돌아왔다. 유다 왕 여호람의 아들 아사랴는 아합의 아들 여호람이 다쳤다는 말을 듣고, 그를 보러 그곳으로 내려갔다. (아사랴는 아하시야의 다른 이름이다.)

pt.L: E voltou para se curar em Jezreel, por causa das feridas com que o tinham ferido em Ramá, quando lutou contra Hazael, rei de Arã. E Azarias, filho de Jorão, rei de Judá, desceu para ver Jorão, filho de Acabe, em Jezreel, porque ele [estava] doente.
pt.B: Ele voltou a Jezreel para se recuperar das feridas que lhe tinham feito em Ramá, na sua batalha contra Hazael, rei dos arameus. Então Azarias, filho de Jorão, rei de Judá, desceu a Jezreel para ver Jorão, filho de Acabe, porque ele estava ferido.
pt.R: Jorão voltou para a cidade de Jezreel para se recuperar das feridas que os arameus lhe tinham feito em Ramá, quando ele lutava contra Hazael, rei dos arameus. Então Azarias, filho de Jorão, o rei de Judá, foi visitar Jorão, filho de Acabe, ali, porque Jorão estava ferido. (Azarias é outra forma do nome Acazias.)

decisions.choice: the same account as 2 Kings 8:29, with small differences
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 8:29 names "Joram the king" as the one who returned and says he was healed "from the wounds"; Chronicles has only "he returned" and "because of the wounds". The sense is the same. Chronicles also calls the king of Judah Azariah (m3) and Ahab's son Jehoram.

decisions.choice: Jezreel and Ramah: Ramah is Ramoth-gilead
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 8:29: Jezreel was the royal town in the valley of that name where Ahab had a palace (1 Kings 21:1). Ramah, "the height", is a short form of Ramoth-gilead (verse 5), not the Ramah near Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: Azariah: the Hebrew text here; Ahaziah in 2 Kings 8:29 and in verses 1-2 and 7
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text names the king of Judah Azariah. 2 Kings 8:29, some Hebrew manuscripts and ancient translations read Ahaziah, which this chapter uses everywhere else. The two names are close in Hebrew writing, and Azariah is most likely a copying slip; it could also be a second name, like Jehoahaz in 21:17. Either way it is the same man, Ahaziah son of Jehoram.

decisions.choice: sick: weak from his wounds
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 8:29: the word means sick or weak; here the weakness comes from the wounds of verse 5.

decisions.choice: they had struck him: the Arameans
decisions.reason: The plural "they" looks back to the Arameans of verse 5.

decisions.choice: wounded (Balanced); hurt (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 8:29: Balanced and Readable say what made him sick; Literal keeps "sick".

decisions.choice: Joram; the Arameans; a note that Azariah is Ahaziah (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable names the people the pronouns refer to (m5), using the form Joram from verse 5, and adds a short note so that the name Azariah does not seem to bring in a new king (m3).

decisions.choice: "(Azarías es otra forma del nombre Ocozías)"
decisions.reason: Readable adds the English Readable's short note, since the Hebrew here has Azarías for the king called Ocozías in verses 1-2 and 7 (m3).

decisions.choice: "Azaria", with a note at Readable that it is another form of "Achazia"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse has Azariah (m3); French keeps the verse's name as the English does.

decisions.choice: "A-xa-ria"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here reads Azariah (m3); Vietnamese keeps it, as the English does, and Readable adds the English note that it is another form of Ahaziah.

decisions.choice: "아사랴" as the Hebrew text reads, with the Readable note that it is Ahaziah
decisions.reason: As in the English (m3, r-en-2); the wording of 2 Kings 8:29 is kept otherwise.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 8:29 in Portuguese, without "o rei Jorão" (L, B) and with "Azarias"
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 2 Kings 8:29 in Portuguese level by level. Where Chronicles differs (m1), so does the Portuguese: the subject is only "he" at Literal and Balanced, the wounds are the reason ("por causa das feridas") at Literal, and the king of Judah is "Azarias", as the Hebrew has it (m3), with Readable's short note, as the English adds one.

source.text: וּמֵֽאֱלֹהִ֗ים הָיְתָה֙ תְּבוּסַ֣ת אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ לָב֖וֹא אֶל־יוֹרָ֑ם וּבְבֹא֗וֹ יָצָ֤א עִם־יְהוֹרָם֙ אֶל־יֵה֣וּא בֶן־נִמְשִׁ֔י אֲשֶׁ֣ר מְשָׁח֣וֹ יְהוָ֔ה לְהַכְרִ֖ית אֶת־בֵּ֥ית אַחְאָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And from God was [the] downfall of Ahaziah, by going to Joram; and when he came, he went out with Jehoram to Jehu son of Nimshi, whom had anointed him Yahweh to cut off [the] house of Ahab.

en.L: And from God was the downfall of Ahaziah, by [his] going to Joram. And when he came, he went out with Jehoram to Jehu son of Nimshi, whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.
en.B: Ahaziah's downfall came from God, through his visit to Joram. When he arrived, he went out with Jehoram to meet Jehu son of Nimshi, whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.
en.R: God brought about Ahaziah's downfall through this visit to Joram. When Ahaziah got there, he went out with Jehoram to meet Jehu son of Nimshi. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} had anointed Jehu to wipe out Ahab's family.

es.L: Y de Dios fue la ruina de Ocozías, por ir a Joram. Y cuando llegó, salió con Jehoram contra Jehú hijo de Nimsi, a quien {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había ungido para exterminar la casa de Acab.
es.B: La ruina de Ocozías vino de Dios, por medio de su visita a Joram. Cuando llegó, salió con Jehoram al encuentro de Jehú hijo de Nimsi, a quien {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había ungido para exterminar la casa de Acab.
es.R: Dios hizo que Ocozías fuera a su ruina por medio de esta visita a Joram. Cuando Ocozías llegó, salió con Jehoram al encuentro de Jehú hijo de Nimsi. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había ungido a Jehú para acabar con la familia de Acab.

fr.L: Et de Dieu vint la ruine d’Achazia, par [sa] venue chez Joram. Et quand il arriva, il sortit avec Yehoram vers Jéhu fils de Nimshi, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait oint pour retrancher la maison d’Achab.
fr.B: La ruine d’Achazia vint de Dieu, par cette visite à Joram. Quand il arriva, il sortit avec Yehoram à la rencontre de Jéhu, fils de Nimshi, que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait oint pour retrancher la maison d’Achab.
fr.R: C’est Dieu qui a provoqué la ruine d’Achazia par cette visite chez Joram. Quand Achazia est arrivé, il est sorti avec Yehoram à la rencontre de Jéhu, fils de Nimshi. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait oint Jéhu pour faire disparaître la famille d’Achab.

sw.L: Na kutoka kwa Mungu kulikuwa anguko la Ahazia, kwa kwenda [kwake] kwa Yoramu. Naye alipofika, akatoka pamoja na Yehoramu kwenda kwa Yehu mwana wa Nimshi, ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amempaka mafuta ili kuikatilia mbali nyumba ya Ahabu.
sw.B: Anguko la Ahazia lilitoka kwa Mungu, kupitia ziara yake kwa Yoramu. Alipofika, alitoka pamoja na Yehoramu kwenda kukutana na Yehu mwana wa Nimshi, ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amempaka mafuta ili kuikatilia mbali nyumba ya Ahabu.
sw.R: Mungu alisababisha anguko la Ahazia kupitia ziara hii kwa Yoramu. Ahazia alipofika huko, alitoka pamoja na Yehoramu kwenda kukutana na Yehu mwana wa Nimshi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amempaka Yehu mafuta ili aiangamize kabisa jamaa ya Ahabu.

vi.L: Sự sụp đổ của A-cha-xia đến từ Đức Chúa Trời, qua việc [vua] đi đến với Giô-ram. Khi đến nơi, vua cùng Giê-hô-ram đi ra gặp Giê-hu con trai Nim-si, là người {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xức dầu để diệt trừ nhà A-háp.
vi.B: Sự sụp đổ của A-cha-xia đến từ Đức Chúa Trời, qua chuyến đi thăm Giô-ram. Khi đến nơi, vua cùng Giê-hô-ram đi ra gặp Giê-hu cháu Nim-si, là người {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xức dầu để diệt trừ nhà A-háp.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời khiến A-cha-xia bị sụp đổ qua chuyến đi thăm Giô-ram này. Khi A-cha-xia đến nơi, vua cùng Giê-hô-ram đi ra gặp Giê-hu cháu Nim-si. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xức dầu cho Giê-hu để quét sạch gia đình A-háp.

ko.L: 그리고 아하시야의 몰락은 하나님에게서 [온 것이었으니], 요람에게 감으로써였다. 그리고 그가 갔을 때에, 그가 여호람과 함께 님시의 아들 예후에게로 나갔다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 아합의 집을 끊어 버리려고 기름 부으신 자였다.
ko.B: 아하시야의 몰락은 하나님께서 정하신 일이었고, 그가 요람을 찾아간 일을 통해 일어났다. 아하시야는 그곳에 이르러 여호람과 함께 님시의 아들 예후를 맞으러 나갔다. 예후는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 아합의 집안을 끊어 버리시려고 기름 부으신 사람이었다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 아하시야가 요람을 찾아간 이 일을 통해 그를 망하게 하셨다. 아하시야는 그곳에 가서 여호람과 함께 님시의 아들 예후를 맞으러 나갔다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 아합의 집안을 쓸어버리시려고 예후에게 기름을 부으셨다.

pt.L: E de Deus veio a ruína de Acazias, por [ele] ir a Jorão. E, quando chegou, saiu com Jorão até Jeú, filho de Ninsi, a quem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha ungido para eliminar a casa de Acabe.
pt.B: A ruína de Acazias veio de Deus, por meio da sua visita a Jorão. Quando chegou, ele saiu com Jorão ao encontro de Jeú, filho de Ninsi, a quem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha ungido para eliminar a casa de Acabe.
pt.R: Deus usou essa visita a Jorão para trazer a queda de Acazias. Quando Acazias chegou, saiu com Jorão ao encontro de Jeú, filho de Ninsi. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} tinha ungido Jeú para acabar com a família de Acabe.

decisions.choice: from God was the downfall of Ahaziah: God's purpose at work
decisions.reason: Chronicles names God as the cause behind the events: Ahaziah's visit to his uncle, chosen on bad counsel (verses 4-5), was the means of his judgment. In the same way it says that the division of the kingdom was "from God" (10:15) and that Amaziah's stubbornness "was from God" (25:20).

decisions.choice: downfall: ruin
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here. It comes from a verb meaning to tread down, and means a fall or ruin.

decisions.choice: Jehu anointed to cut off the house of Ahab: 2 Kings 9
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 9:1-10 tells how a prophet sent by Elisha anointed Jehu king of Israel and gave him Yahweh's charge to strike down the house of Ahab, as Elijah had said (1 Kings 21:21-24). 2 Kings 9:21 tells how the two kings rode out to meet him. Chronicles assumes the reader knows that story.

decisions.choice: Joram ... Jehoram: one man
decisions.reason: The verse calls Ahab's son first Joram and then Jehoram, the shorter and longer forms of his name (verse 5).

decisions.choice: to meet (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Went out ... to Jehu" means went out to meet him (2 Kings 9:21).

decisions.choice: cut off (Literal, Balanced); wipe out (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Cut off" a family means to destroy it so that it has no descendants left; Readable says so plainly.

decisions.choice: "Giê-hu cháu Nim-si" (B, R); "con trai Nim-si" (L)
decisions.reason: Jehu was the son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi (2 Kings 9:2); the 2 Kings drafts say "cháu Nim-si" at Balanced and Readable, and this verse follows them.

decisions.choice: a ruína (L, B), a queda (R); Jeú, filho de Ninsi; eliminar (L, B), acabar com (R)
decisions.reason: The rare word for a downfall (m2) is "ruína" at Literal and Balanced and "queda" at Readable. "Jeú" and "Ninsi" as 2 Kings 9:2 has them in Portuguese, and "eliminar" is the verb 2 Kings 9:8 uses in Portuguese for cutting off Ahab's house (m3); "ao encontro de" at Balanced and Readable as 2 Kings 9:21.

source.text: וַיְהִ֕י כְּהִשָּׁפֵ֥ט יֵה֖וּא עִם־בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וַיִּמְצָא֩ אֶת־שָׂרֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה וּבְנֵ֨י אֲחֵ֧י אֲחַזְיָ֛הוּ מְשָׁרְתִ֥ים לַאֲחַזְיָ֖הוּ וַיַּהַרְגֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when entering into judgment Jehu with [the] house of Ahab, and he found [the] princes of Judah and [the] sons of [the] brothers of Ahaziah serving Ahaziah, and he killed them.

en.L: And it happened, when Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, [that] he found the princes of Judah and the sons of the brothers of Ahaziah, serving Ahaziah, and he killed them.
en.B: While Jehu was carrying out judgment on the house of Ahab, he found the officials of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah's brothers who were attending Ahaziah, and he killed them.
en.R: While Jehu was punishing Ahab's family, he came upon the leaders of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah's brothers, who were in Ahaziah's service. Jehu killed them.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando Jehú hacía juicio contra la casa de Acab, halló a los príncipes de Judá y a los hijos de los hermanos de Ocozías, que servían a Ocozías, y los mató.
es.B: Mientras Jehú ejecutaba el juicio contra la casa de Acab, encontró a los jefes de Judá y a los hijos de los hermanos de Ocozías que estaban al servicio de Ocozías, y los mató.
es.R: Mientras Jehú castigaba a la familia de Acab, encontró a los dirigentes de Judá y a los sobrinos de Ocozías, que estaban a su servicio. Jehú los mató.

fr.L: Et il arriva, comme Jéhu exécutait le jugement sur la maison d’Achab, qu’il trouva les princes de Juda et les fils des frères d’Achazia, qui servaient Achazia, et il les tua.
fr.B: Pendant que Jéhu exécutait le jugement contre la maison d’Achab, il trouva les chefs de Juda et les fils des frères d’Achazia qui étaient au service d’Achazia, et il les tua.
fr.R: Pendant que Jéhu punissait la famille d’Achab, il a rencontré les chefs de Juda et les fils des frères d’Achazia, qui étaient au service d’Achazia. Jéhu les a tués.

sw.L: Ikawa Yehu alipokuwa akitekeleza hukumu juu ya nyumba ya Ahabu, akawakuta wakuu wa Yuda na wana wa ndugu zake Ahazia, wakimtumikia Ahazia, akawaua.
sw.B: Yehu alipokuwa akitekeleza hukumu juu ya nyumba ya Ahabu, aliwakuta maafisa wa Yuda na wana wa ndugu zake Ahazia waliokuwa wakimhudumia Ahazia, akawaua.
sw.R: Yehu alipokuwa akiiadhibu jamaa ya Ahabu, aliwakuta viongozi wa Yuda na wana wa ndugu zake Ahazia, waliokuwa watumishi wa Ahazia. Yehu akawaua.

vi.L: Khi Giê-hu đang thi hành sự đoán phạt trên nhà A-háp, ông gặp các thủ lĩnh Giu-đa và các con trai của anh em A-cha-xia đang phục vụ A-cha-xia, và ông giết họ.
vi.B: Trong khi Giê-hu đang thi hành sự đoán phạt trên nhà A-háp, ông gặp các quan chức Giu-đa và các con trai của anh em A-cha-xia đang phục vụ A-cha-xia, và ông giết họ.
vi.R: Trong khi Giê-hu đang trừng phạt gia đình A-háp, ông gặp các người lãnh đạo Giu-đa và các con trai của anh em A-cha-xia, là những người đang phục vụ A-cha-xia. Giê-hu giết họ.

ko.L: 그리고 예후가 아합의 집에 심판을 집행할 때에, 그가 유다의 지도자들과 아하시야의 형제들의 아들들이 아하시야를 섬기고 있는 것을 발견하고, 그들을 죽였다.
ko.B: 예후는 아합의 집안에 심판을 집행하다가, 아하시야를 시중들던 유다의 관리들과 아하시야의 조카들을 만나 그들을 죽였다.
ko.R: 예후는 아합의 집안을 벌하다가, 유다의 지도자들과 아하시야의 조카들을 만났다. 그들은 아하시야를 섬기던 사람들이었다. 예후는 그들을 죽였다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando Jeú executava o julgamento sobre a casa de Acabe, encontrou os príncipes de Judá e os filhos dos irmãos de Acazias, que serviam a Acazias, e os matou.
pt.B: Enquanto Jeú executava o julgamento sobre a casa de Acabe, encontrou os oficiais de Judá e os filhos dos irmãos de Acazias, que estavam a serviço de Acazias, e os matou.
pt.R: Enquanto Jeú castigava a família de Acabe, ele encontrou os líderes de Judá e os filhos dos irmãos de Acazias, que estavam a serviço dele. Jeú matou todos eles.

decisions.choice: the killing of Ahaziah's relatives: 2 Kings 10:12-14
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 10:12-14 tells how Jehu met forty-two relatives of Ahaziah on the road and had them killed. Kings calls them Ahaziah's brothers; Chronicles calls them the sons of his brothers, since his brothers had been killed in the Arab raid (21:17; 22:1). Chronicles also names the officials of Judah with them, and tells this before Ahaziah's own death, where Kings tells it after.

decisions.choice: executing judgment on the house of Ahab: carrying out God's sentence
decisions.reason: The verb form means to enter into judgment with someone, here to carry out a sentence on them. Jehu acts as the instrument of the judgment of verse 7.

decisions.choice: serving Ahaziah: attending him
decisions.reason: The word is used of personal attendants and court servants; these men were in the king's company on his visit to the north.

decisions.choice: princes (Literal); officials (Balanced); leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for these men of rank (sar) in a civil setting.

decisions.choice: punishing (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of "executing judgment" in an everyday word.

decisions.choice: "아하시야의 조카들" for "the sons of Ahaziah's brothers"
decisions.reason: Korean has the one word for a brother's son; Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: os príncipes (L), os oficiais (B), os líderes (R); os filhos dos irmãos de Acazias
decisions.reason: The men of rank (r-en-1) are "príncipes", "oficiais" and "líderes", the Portuguese of each English level. Chronicles calls the victims the sons of Ahaziah's brothers where 2 Kings 10:13 has "irmãos", in Portuguese "parentes" at Balanced (m1), so the Portuguese keeps "os filhos dos irmãos" at every level, rather than "sobrinhos", which would take in sisters' sons too.

source.text: וַיְבַקֵּשׁ֩ אֶת־אֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ וַֽיִּלְכְּדֻ֜הוּ וְה֧וּא מִתְחַבֵּ֣א בְשֹֽׁמְר֗וֹן וַיְבִאֻ֣הוּ אֶל־יֵהוּא֮ וַיְמִתֻהוּ֒ וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֔הוּ כִּ֤י אָֽמְרוּ֙ בֶּן־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁר־דָּרַ֥שׁ אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה בְּכָל־לְבָב֑וֹ וְאֵין֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ לַעְצֹ֥ר כֹּ֖חַ לְמַמְלָכָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he sought Ahaziah, and they captured him, and he [was] hiding himself in Samaria, and they brought him to Jehu and put him to death and buried him, for they said, [A] son of Jehoshaphat [is] he, who sought Yahweh with all his heart; and there was not to [the] house of Ahaziah to retain strength for [the] kingdom.

en.L: And he sought Ahaziah, and they captured him while he was hiding in Samaria, and they brought him to Jehu and put him to death. And they buried him, for they said, "He [is] a son of Jehoshaphat, who sought {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with all his heart." And there was no [one] in the house of Ahaziah to retain strength for the kingdom.
en.B: Then he searched for Ahaziah. They captured him as he was hiding in Samaria, brought him to Jehu, and put him to death. They buried him, because they said, "He is a grandson of Jehoshaphat, who sought {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with all his heart." And no one was left in the house of Ahaziah with the strength to hold the kingdom.
en.R: Then Jehu searched for Ahaziah. His men caught Ahaziah hiding in Samaria and brought him to Jehu, and they killed him. But they buried him, because they said, "He was Jehoshaphat's grandson, and Jehoshaphat sought {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with all his heart." So no one in Ahaziah's family was left who was strong enough to rule the kingdom.

es.L: Y buscó a Ocozías, y lo capturaron mientras se escondía en Samaria, y lo trajeron a Jehú y le dieron muerte. Y lo sepultaron, porque dijeron: «Hijo de Josafat [es] él, que buscó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con todo su corazón». Y no hubo [nadie] en la casa de Ocozías que retuviera fuerza para el reino.
es.B: Luego buscó a Ocozías. Lo capturaron cuando se escondía en Samaria, lo llevaron ante Jehú y le dieron muerte. Lo sepultaron, porque dijeron: «Es nieto de Josafat, que buscó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con todo su corazón». Y no quedó nadie en la casa de Ocozías con fuerza para conservar el reino.
es.R: Luego Jehú buscó a Ocozías. Sus hombres lo encontraron escondido en Samaria y lo llevaron ante Jehú, y lo mataron. Pero lo sepultaron, porque dijeron: «Era nieto de Josafat, y Josafat buscó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con todo su corazón». Así no quedó nadie en la familia de Ocozías con fuerza suficiente para gobernar el reino.

fr.L: Et il chercha Achazia, et on le captura alors qu’il se cachait à Samarie, et on l’amena à Jéhu, et on le fit mourir. Et on l’enterra, car on disait : « Il [est] fils de Josaphat, qui a cherché {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de tout son cœur. » Et il n’y eut personne dans la maison d’Achazia pour garder la force de régner.
fr.B: Puis il rechercha Achazia. On le captura alors qu’il se cachait à Samarie, on l’amena à Jéhu et on le mit à mort. On l’enterra, car on disait : « C’est le petit-fils de Josaphat, qui a cherché {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de tout son cœur. » Et il ne resta dans la maison d’Achazia personne qui eût la force de garder le royaume.
fr.R: Ensuite Jéhu a recherché Achazia. Ses hommes l’ont trouvé caché à Samarie et ils l’ont amené à Jéhu. Puis ils l’ont tué. Mais ils l’ont enterré, parce qu’ils disaient : « C’était le petit-fils de Josaphat, et Josaphat a cherché {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de tout son cœur. » Ainsi, dans la famille d’Achazia, il n’est resté personne d’assez fort pour gouverner le royaume.

sw.L: Akamtafuta Ahazia, nao wakamkamata alipokuwa amejificha huko Samaria, wakamleta kwa Yehu, wakamuua. Nao wakamzika, kwa maana walisema, "Yeye [ni] mwana wa Yehoshafati, aliyemtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa moyo wake wote." Wala hapakuwa na [mtu] katika nyumba ya Ahazia wa kushika nguvu ya ufalme.
sw.B: Kisha akamtafuta Ahazia. Wakamkamata alipokuwa amejificha huko Samaria, wakamleta kwa Yehu, wakamuua. Wakamzika, kwa sababu walisema, "Yeye ni mjukuu wa Yehoshafati, aliyemtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa moyo wake wote." Wala hakubaki mtu katika nyumba ya Ahazia mwenye nguvu za kuushika ufalme.
sw.R: Kisha Yehu akamtafuta Ahazia. Watu wake wakamkuta Ahazia amejificha huko Samaria, wakamleta kwa Yehu, wakamuua. Lakini wakamzika, kwa sababu walisema, "Alikuwa mjukuu wa Yehoshafati, na Yehoshafati alimtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa moyo wake wote." Kwa hiyo hakubaki mtu katika jamaa ya Ahazia mwenye nguvu za kutawala ufalme.

vi.L: Ông tìm A-cha-xia; người ta bắt được vua khi vua đang ẩn mình tại Sa-ma-ri, đem vua đến Giê-hu và giết vua. Người ta chôn vua, vì nói rằng: "Hắn [là] con trai Giô-sa-phát, người đã hết lòng tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Và trong nhà A-cha-xia không còn [ai] đủ sức giữ vương quốc.
vi.B: Rồi Giê-hu tìm A-cha-xia. Người ta bắt được vua đang trốn tại Sa-ma-ri, đem đến Giê-hu và xử tử vua. Họ chôn vua, vì họ nói: "Hắn là cháu Giô-sa-phát, người đã hết lòng tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Và trong nhà A-cha-xia không còn ai đủ sức giữ vương quốc.
vi.R: Rồi Giê-hu đi tìm A-cha-xia. Người của Giê-hu bắt được A-cha-xia đang trốn tại Sa-ma-ri và đem đến Giê-hu, rồi họ giết vua. Nhưng họ chôn vua, vì họ nói: "Hắn là cháu của Giô-sa-phát, và Giô-sa-phát đã hết lòng tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}." Vậy trong gia đình A-cha-xia không còn ai đủ mạnh để cai trị vương quốc.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 아하시야를 찾았고, 그들이 사마리아에 숨어 있던 그를 붙잡아 예후에게 끌고 가서 죽였다. 그리고 그들이 그를 묻어 주었다. 그들이 "그는 온 마음으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾은 여호사밧의 아들이다." 하고 말했기 때문이다. 그리고 아하시야의 집에는 나라를 지킬 힘을 가진 자가 없었다.
ko.B: 예후가 아하시야를 찾자, 그의 부하들이 사마리아에 숨어 있던 아하시야를 붙잡아 예후에게 끌고 가서 죽였다. 그들은 아하시야를 묻어 주었다. "그는 온 마음으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾은 여호사밧의 손자다." 하고 말했기 때문이다. 아하시야의 집안에는 나라를 지킬 만한 힘을 가진 사람이 아무도 남지 않았다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 예후는 아하시야를 찾아 나섰다. 예후의 부하들은 사마리아에 숨어 있던 아하시야를 붙잡아 예후에게 끌고 가서 죽였다. 그러나 그들은 아하시야를 묻어 주었다. "이 사람은 여호사밧의 손자다. 여호사밧은 온 마음으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾은 사람이었다." 하고 말했기 때문이다. 그래서 아하시야의 집안에는 나라를 다스릴 만큼 힘 있는 사람이 하나도 남지 않았다.

pt.L: E ele procurou Acazias, e o capturaram enquanto ele se escondia em Samaria, e o trouxeram a Jeú e o mataram. E o sepultaram, porque disseram: "Ele [é] filho de Josafá, que buscou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} de todo o seu coração." E não havia [ninguém] na casa de Acazias para reter força para o reino.
pt.B: Então ele procurou Acazias. Eles o capturaram quando ele estava escondido em Samaria, o levaram a Jeú e o mataram. Eles o sepultaram, porque disseram: "Ele é neto de Josafá, que buscou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} de todo o coração." E não ficou ninguém na casa de Acazias com força para manter o reino.
pt.R: Então Jeú procurou Acazias. Os homens de Jeú encontraram Acazias escondido em Samaria e o levaram a Jeú, e eles o mataram. Mas o sepultaram, porque disseram: "Ele era neto de Josafá, e Josafá buscou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} de todo o coração." Assim, não sobrou ninguém na família de Acazias que fosse forte o bastante para governar o reino.

decisions.choice: Ahaziah's death: told differently from 2 Kings 9:27-28
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 9:27-28 says that Ahaziah fled from Jezreel, was shot near Ibleam, escaped to Megiddo and died there, and that his servants took his body to Jerusalem and buried him in the City of David. Chronicles says he was found hiding in Samaria, brought to Jehu and put to death, and does not say where he was buried. The two accounts come from different sources, and neither text explains how they fit together. One suggestion is that Chronicles gives a short summary of the same events.

decisions.choice: the grandson of Jehoshaphat who sought Yahweh with all his heart: honor for the grandfather's sake
decisions.reason: Chronicles praises Jehoshaphat as a king who sought Yahweh (17:4; 19:3; compare 20:3). Even Jehu's men, or Ahaziah's own people, gave the grandson a burial out of respect for him. A wicked king is buried because of a faithful one, as Yahweh kept a lamp for David's sake (21:7).

decisions.choice: son of Jehoshaphat: grandson
decisions.reason: "Son" can mean any descendant. Ahaziah was the son of Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat.

decisions.choice: they captured, brought, put to death, buried: the subject is not named
decisions.reason: The plural verbs most likely mean Jehu's men. Those who buried him could also be Ahaziah's own servants, as in 2 Kings 9:28.

decisions.choice: no one to retain strength for the kingdom: no one able to hold the throne
decisions.reason: The phrase means that no one in the royal house was strong enough to take and keep power. With the king and his relatives dead, the way was open for Athaliah (verse 10).

decisions.choice: son (Literal); grandson (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "son" means here (m3).

decisions.choice: Jehu; his men (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable names who searched and who made the capture (m4).

decisions.choice: "Hijo" (L); "nieto" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "son" means here (m3), as the English does.

decisions.choice: Jehu's men speak of Ahaziah as "hắn"
decisions.reason: They are the king's enemies who have just killed him; they still honor his grandfather.

decisions.choice: "그의 부하들이" at Balanced
decisions.reason: Korean needs a subject when it changes from Jehu to those who captured Ahaziah; Balanced names them as the English Readable does (m4).

decisions.choice: filho (L), neto (B, R); buscou (every level)
decisions.reason: Ahaziah's death is told in Chronicles' own words (m1), not those of 2 Kings 9:27-28, so the Portuguese is drafted from this Hebrew. "Buscar" is the Chronicler's word for seeking God, as 1:5 sets it for the book; "neto" at Balanced and Readable as the English says "grandson" (m3).

source.text: וַעֲתַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֵ֣ם אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ רָאֲתָ֖ה כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת בְּנָ֑הּ וַתָּ֗קָם וַתְּדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־כָּל־זֶ֥רַע הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה לְבֵ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And Athaliah, mother of Ahaziah, saw that dead [was] her son, and arose and destroyed all [the] offspring of the kingdom of [the] house of Judah.

en.L: And Athaliah, the mother of Ahaziah, saw that her son [was] dead, and she arose and destroyed all the offspring of the kingdom of the house of Judah.
en.B: Athaliah, Ahaziah's mother, saw that her son was dead, and she set out to destroy the whole royal family of the house of Judah.
en.R: Ahaziah's mother Athaliah saw that her son was dead. So she started killing everyone in the royal family of Judah.

es.L: Y Atalía, madre de Ocozías, vio que su hijo [estaba] muerto, y se levantó y exterminó a toda la descendencia real de la casa de Judá.
es.B: Atalía, la madre de Ocozías, vio que su hijo había muerto, y se puso a exterminar a toda la familia real de la casa de Judá.
es.R: Atalía, la madre de Ocozías, vio que su hijo había muerto. Entonces empezó a matar a todos los de la familia real de Judá.

fr.L: Et Athalie, mère d’Achazia, vit que son fils [était] mort, et elle se leva et extermina toute la descendance royale de la maison de Juda.
fr.B: Athalie, mère d’Achazia, vit que son fils était mort, et elle entreprit d’exterminer toute la famille royale de la maison de Juda.
fr.R: Athalie, la mère d’Achazia, a vu que son fils était mort. Alors elle a commencé à tuer tous les membres de la famille royale de Juda.

sw.L: Athalia, mama wa Ahazia, akaona kwamba mwanawe amekufa, akainuka, akaangamiza uzao wote wa kifalme wa nyumba ya Yuda.
sw.B: Athalia, mama wa Ahazia, alipoona kwamba mwanawe amekufa, aliinuka kuangamiza jamaa yote ya kifalme ya nyumba ya Yuda.
sw.R: Athalia mama wa Ahazia aliona kwamba mwanawe amekufa. Basi akaanza kuwaua watu wote wa jamaa ya kifalme ya Yuda.

vi.L: A-tha-li, mẹ của A-cha-xia, thấy con trai mình đã chết, thì đứng dậy tiêu diệt cả dòng dõi hoàng tộc của nhà Giu-đa.
vi.B: A-tha-li, mẹ của A-cha-xia, thấy con trai mình đã chết, liền ra tay tiêu diệt cả hoàng tộc nhà Giu-đa.
vi.R: Bà A-tha-li, mẹ của A-cha-xia, thấy con trai mình đã chết. Vì vậy bà bắt đầu giết hết mọi người trong hoàng tộc Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 아하시야의 어머니 아달랴가 자기 아들이 죽은 것을 보고, 일어나 유다 집의 왕국의 자손을 모두 멸했다.
ko.B: 아하시야의 어머니 아달랴는 자기 아들이 죽은 것을 보고, 유다 집안의 왕족을 모두 없애려고 나섰다.
ko.R: 아하시야의 어머니 아달랴는 자기 아들이 죽은 것을 알았다. 그래서 그는 유다 왕의 집안사람들을 모두 죽이기 시작했다.

pt.L: E Atalia, mãe de Acazias, viu que o seu filho [estava] morto, e se levantou e destruiu toda a descendência do reino da casa de Judá.
pt.B: Atalia, mãe de Acazias, viu que o seu filho estava morto e começou a exterminar toda a família real da casa de Judá.
pt.R: Atalia, a mãe de Acazias, viu que o seu filho estava morto. Então ela começou a matar todos da família real de Judá.

decisions.choice: the same words as 2 Kings 11:1, with "of the house of Judah" added
decisions.reason: This verse and the next two repeat 2 Kings 11:1-3, and the wording here follows it. Chronicles adds "of the house of Judah" and uses a different verb for "destroyed" (m2).

decisions.choice: destroyed: a rare sense of the verb
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 11:1 has the common verb for destroying. Chronicles has a verb that usually means to speak, used here in a rarer sense, to subdue or destroy. The meaning of the verse is the same.

decisions.choice: the offspring of the kingdom: the royal family
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:1: the king's descendants, the line from which the next king would come.

decisions.choice: arose and destroyed: she set about killing them
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:1: "arose" marks the start of a deliberate action. Verse 11 shows that one child escaped.

decisions.choice: set out to destroy (Balanced); started killing (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:1: Balanced and Readable show that she began the killing but did not finish it (verse 11).

decisions.choice: the wording of Spanish 2 Kings 11:1
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the Spanish of 2 Kings 11:1 at each level, adding "de la casa de Judá" as the Hebrew of Chronicles does (m1).

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 11:1 with "của nhà Giu-đa" added
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats 2 Kings 11:1 and adds "of the house of Judah" (m1), so the Vietnamese Kings wording is reused with that addition.

decisions.choice: The wording of 2 Kings 11:1 with "유다 집(안)의" added
decisions.reason: Chronicles adds "of the house of Judah" (m1); the different Hebrew verb for destroying has the same sense and is rendered as in Kings.

decisions.choice: Atalia; the wording of 2 Kings 11:1 in Portuguese, with "da casa de Judá" (L, B) and "de Judá" (R) added
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 11:1 at each level, "Atalia" and "a descendência do reino" (L), "a família real" (B, R) included (m3), and adds only what Chronicles adds (m1). Chronicles' rarer verb for "destroyed" (m2) has the same sense, so the Portuguese verbs stay as in Kings.

source.text: וַתִּקַּח֩ יְהוֹשַׁבְעַ֨ת בַּת־הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־יוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָ֗הוּ וַתִּגְנֹ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ מִתּ֤וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַמּ֣וּמָתִ֔ים וַתִּתֵּ֥ן אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־מֵֽינִקְתּ֖וֹ בַּחֲדַ֣ר הַמִּטּ֑וֹת וַתַּסְתִּירֵ֡הוּ יְהוֹשַׁבְעַ֣ת בַּת־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹרָ֡ם אֵשֶׁת֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַכֹּהֵ֜ן כִּ֣י הִיא֩ הָיְתָ֨ה אֲח֧וֹת אֲחַזְיָ֛הוּ מִפְּנֵ֥י עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ וְלֹ֥א הֱמִיתָֽתְהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Jehoshabeath, daughter of the king, Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him from among [the] sons of the king who [were] being put to death, and she put him and his nurse in [the] room of the beds; and hid him Jehoshabeath, daughter of the king Jehoram, wife of Jehoiada the priest, for she was [the] sister of Ahaziah, from before Athaliah, and not she put him to death.

en.L: And Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the sons of the king who were being put to death, and she put him and his nurse in the room of the beds. And Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, for she was the sister of Ahaziah, hid him from Athaliah, and she did not put him to death.
en.B: But Jehoshabeath, the king's daughter, took Ahaziah's son Joash and secretly took him out from among the king's sons who were about to be killed, and she put him and his nurse in the bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, King Jehoram's daughter and the wife of Jehoiada the priest, hid him from Athaliah, since she was Ahaziah's sister, and Athaliah did not kill him.
en.R: But Jehoshabeath, the king's daughter, took Ahaziah's son Joash. The king's sons were about to be killed, but she secretly took him away from among them. She put him and his nurse in a bedroom. Jehoshabeath was King Jehoram's daughter, Ahaziah's sister, and the wife of Jehoiada the priest. She hid the boy from Athaliah, so Athaliah did not kill him.

es.L: Pero Josabet, hija del rey, tomó a Joás hijo de Ocozías y lo sacó a escondidas de entre los hijos del rey a quienes estaban matando, y lo puso a él y a su nodriza en el cuarto de las camas. Y Josabet, hija del rey Jehoram, mujer del sacerdote Joiada, porque era hermana de Ocozías, lo escondió de Atalía, y no lo mató.
es.B: Pero Josabet, la hija del rey, tomó a Joás, el hijo de Ocozías, y lo sacó a escondidas de entre los hijos del rey a quienes iban a matar, y lo puso con su nodriza en el dormitorio. Así Josabet, hija del rey Jehoram y esposa del sacerdote Joiada, lo escondió de Atalía, pues era hermana de Ocozías, y Atalía no lo mató.
es.R: Pero Josabet, la hija del rey, tomó a Joás, el hijo de Ocozías. Iban a matar a los hijos del rey, pero ella lo sacó a escondidas de entre ellos. Lo puso con su nodriza en un dormitorio. Josabet era hija del rey Jehoram, hermana de Ocozías y esposa del sacerdote Joiada. Ella escondió al niño de Atalía, y así Atalía no lo mató.

fr.L: Et Yehoshabeath, la fille du roi, prit Joas fils d’Achazia et l’enleva du milieu des fils du roi qu’on faisait mourir, et elle le mit, lui et sa nourrice, dans la chambre des lits. Et Yehoshabeath, fille du roi Yehoram, femme de Yehoyada le prêtre, car elle était la sœur d’Achazia, le cacha devant Athalie, et elle ne le fit pas mourir.
fr.B: Mais Yehoshabeath, la fille du roi, prit Joas, fils d’Achazia, et l’enleva en secret du milieu des fils du roi qu’on allait tuer. Elle le mit avec sa nourrice dans la chambre à coucher. Ainsi Yehoshabeath, fille du roi Yehoram et femme du prêtre Yehoyada, le cacha à Athalie, puisqu’elle était la sœur d’Achazia, et Athalie ne le tua pas.
fr.R: Mais Yehoshabeath, la fille du roi, a pris Joas, le fils d’Achazia. On allait tuer les fils du roi, mais elle l’a emmené en secret du milieu d’eux. Elle l’a mis avec sa nourrice dans une chambre à coucher. Yehoshabeath était la fille du roi Yehoram, la sœur d’Achazia et la femme du prêtre Yehoyada. Elle a caché l’enfant à Athalie, et Athalie ne l’a donc pas tué.

sw.L: Lakini Yehoshabeathi, binti mfalme, akamchukua Yoashi mwana wa Ahazia, akamwiba kutoka katikati ya wana wa mfalme waliokuwa wakiuawa, akamweka yeye na mlezi wake katika chumba cha vitanda. Naye Yehoshabeathi, binti mfalme Yehoramu, mke wa Yehoyada kuhani, kwa maana alikuwa dada yake Ahazia, akamficha mbele ya Athalia, wala hakumuua.
sw.B: Lakini Yehoshabeathi, binti wa mfalme, alimchukua Yoashi mwana wa Ahazia, akamtoa kwa siri katikati ya wana wa mfalme waliokuwa karibu kuuawa, akamweka yeye na mlezi wake katika chumba cha kulala. Basi Yehoshabeathi, binti wa mfalme Yehoramu na mke wa Yehoyada kuhani, akamficha Athalia asimwone, kwa kuwa alikuwa dada yake Ahazia, naye Athalia hakumuua.
sw.R: Lakini Yehoshabeathi, binti wa mfalme, alimchukua Yoashi mwana wa Ahazia. Wana wa mfalme walikuwa karibu kuuawa, lakini yeye akamtoa kwa siri katikati yao. Akamweka yeye na mlezi wake katika chumba cha kulala. Yehoshabeathi alikuwa binti wa mfalme Yehoramu, dada yake Ahazia, na mke wa Yehoyada kuhani. Alimficha mtoto huyo Athalia asimwone, kwa hiyo Athalia hakumuua.

vi.L: Nhưng Giô-sê-ba-át, con gái vua, đem Giô-ách con trai A-cha-xia, lén đem cậu ra khỏi giữa các con trai vua đang bị giết, và đặt cậu cùng người vú nuôi trong phòng ngủ. Giô-sê-ba-át, con gái vua Giê-hô-ram, vợ của thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa, vì bà là chị của A-cha-xia, đã giấu cậu khỏi A-tha-li, nên bà ta không giết được cậu.
vi.B: Nhưng Giô-sê-ba-át, con gái vua, bế Giô-ách con trai A-cha-xia, lén đưa cậu ra khỏi giữa các hoàng tử sắp bị giết, và để cậu cùng người vú nuôi trong phòng ngủ. Vậy Giô-sê-ba-át, con gái vua Giê-hô-ram và vợ thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa, đã giấu cậu khỏi A-tha-li, vì bà là chị của A-cha-xia, nên A-tha-li không giết được cậu.
vi.R: Nhưng Giô-sê-ba-át, con gái vua, đã bế Giô-ách con trai A-cha-xia đi. Các hoàng tử sắp bị giết, nhưng bà lén đưa cậu ra khỏi giữa họ. Bà để cậu cùng người vú nuôi trong một phòng ngủ. Giô-sê-ba-át là con gái vua Giê-hô-ram, chị của A-cha-xia, và là vợ thầy tế lễ Giê-hô-gia-đa. Bà giấu cậu bé khỏi A-tha-li, nên A-tha-li không giết được cậu.

ko.L: 그리고 왕의 딸 여호사브앗이 아하시야의 아들 요아스를 데려다가, 죽임을 당하고 있는 왕의 아들들 가운데서 몰래 빼내어, 그와 그의 유모를 침실에 두었다. 그리고 여호람 왕의 딸이며 제사장 여호야다의 아내인 여호사브앗이, 그가 아하시야의 누이였으므로, 그를 아달랴에게서 숨겨서, 그[녀]가 그를 죽이지 못했다.
ko.B: 그러나 왕의 딸 여호사브앗이 아하시야의 아들 요아스를 데리고, 죽임을 당하게 된 왕자들 가운데서 몰래 빼내어, 요아스와 그의 유모를 침실에 숨겼다. 여호람 왕의 딸이며 제사장 여호야다의 아내인 여호사브앗은 아하시야의 누이였으므로, 이렇게 요아스를 아달랴에게서 숨겼다. 그래서 아달랴는 요아스를 죽이지 못했다.
ko.R: 그러나 왕의 딸 여호사브앗이 아하시야의 아들 요아스를 데려갔다. 왕자들이 막 죽임을 당하려 할 때에, 여호사브앗은 그들 가운데서 요아스를 몰래 빼내었다. 그리고 요아스와 그의 유모를 침실에 숨겼다. 여호사브앗은 여호람 왕의 딸이고, 아하시야의 누이이며, 제사장 여호야다의 아내였다. 그는 그 아이를 아달랴에게서 숨겼다. 그래서 아달랴는 그 아이를 죽이지 못했다.

pt.L: E Jeosabeate, filha do rei, tomou Joás, filho de Acazias, e o roubou do meio dos filhos do rei que estavam sendo mortos, e pôs a ele e à sua ama no quarto das camas. E Jeosabeate, filha do rei Jorão, mulher de Joiada, o sacerdote, porque ela era irmã de Acazias, o escondeu de Atalia, e ela não o matou.
pt.B: Mas Jeosabeate, filha do rei, pegou Joás, filho de Acazias, e o tirou às escondidas do meio dos filhos do rei que iam ser mortos. Ela o pôs com a sua ama no quarto de dormir. Assim Jeosabeate, filha do rei Jorão e mulher do sacerdote Joiada, o escondeu de Atalia, já que era irmã de Acazias, e Atalia não o matou.
pt.R: Mas Jeosabeate, a filha do rei, pegou Joás, o filho de Acazias. Os filhos do rei estavam para ser mortos, mas ela tirou o menino do meio deles às escondidas. Ela o pôs com a sua ama num quarto de dormir. Jeosabeate era filha do rei Jorão, irmã de Acazias e mulher do sacerdote Joiada. Ela escondeu o menino de Atalia, e assim Atalia não o matou.

decisions.choice: the same account as 2 Kings 11:2, with differences
decisions.reason: The wording follows 2 Kings 11:2 where the Hebrew is the same. The differences: Chronicles spells her name Jehoshabeath, a longer form of Jehosheba; it calls her first simply "the king's daughter"; it gives the verb "she put" that Kings leaves out; it says "she hid him" where Kings has "they hid him"; it adds that she was the wife of Jehoiada the priest; and it ends "she did not put him to death", meaning Athaliah, where Kings has "he was not put to death".

decisions.choice: the wife of Jehoiada the priest: how the child could be hidden in the temple
decisions.reason: Only Chronicles says that Jehoshabeath was married to Jehoiada. Her husband's place in the temple explains how Joash could be hidden there for six years (verse 12), and Jehoiada leads the plot that crowns him (chapter 23).

decisions.choice: the room of the beds: a bedroom
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:2: a room for beds, either a bedroom or a storeroom for beds and bedding. Either way it was a place where a small child and his nurse could be kept out of sight.

decisions.choice: for she was the sister of Ahaziah; she did not put him to death
decisions.reason: The clause about her being Ahaziah's sister explains why she, the king's daughter, could and would rescue his son. The last verb is feminine and refers to Athaliah: she did not succeed in killing him.

decisions.choice: who were being put to death: the killing was under way
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:2: the king's sons were in the process of being killed when she took the child out from among them.

decisions.choice: the bedroom (Balanced); a bedroom (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:2: the everyday word for a room for beds; the footnote on m3 gives the other possible sense.

decisions.choice: the reason and the subject made plain (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced moves "since she was Ahaziah's sister" after the main verb and names Athaliah as the one who did not kill him (m4). Readable gives Jehoshabeath's family ties in a sentence of their own and calls Joash "the boy".

decisions.choice: "Josabet"; "el sacerdote Joiada"
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the princess's name differently from 2 Kings 11:2 (Josaba); Spanish keeps each book's form, as the English does. Joiada is the usual Spanish form of Jehoiada.

decisions.choice: "Yehoshabeath"
decisions.reason: The verse's own longer form of the name that French 2 Kings 11:2 writes "Yehosheba", transcribed the same way.

decisions.choice: "Giô-sê-ba-át", "chị của A-cha-xia"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew spells her name Jehoshabeath here (Jehosheba in 2 Kings 11:2), so the form changes as the English does; "chị" follows the 2 Kings draft, which is uncertain because the Hebrew does not say who was older.

decisions.choice: "여호사브앗", the longer form Chronicles uses
decisions.reason: Each book keeps its own spelling of the name, as the English does (m1); the rest follows the Korean wording of 2 Kings 11:2.

decisions.choice: Jeosabeate; Joás; a sua ama; Joiada, o sacerdote (L), o sacerdote Joiada (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 11:2 where the Hebrew is the same (m1): "Joás", "a sua ama", "o roubou" (L), "o tirou às escondidas" (B, R), "o quarto das camas" (L), "quarto de dormir" (B, R). The princess's name takes Chronicles' longer form, "Jeosabeate", where 2 Kings has "Jeoseba", as the English writes "Jehoshabeath" here and "Jehosheba" there. "Joiada" and the order of his title as 2 Kings 11:4 sets them in Portuguese.

records.literal_gloss: And he was with them in [the] house of God hiding himself six years, and Athaliah [was] reigning over the land.

en.L: And he was with them in the house of God, hiding, six years, while Athaliah was reigning over the land.
en.B: He stayed hidden with them in the house of God six years, during Athaliah's rule over the land.
en.R: For six years Joash stayed hidden with them in God's temple, while Athaliah ruled the country as queen.

es.L: Y estuvo con ellos escondido en la casa de Dios seis años, mientras Atalía reinaba sobre el país.
es.B: Estuvo escondido con ellos en la casa de Dios durante seis años, mientras Atalía gobernaba el país.
es.R: Durante seis años Joás estuvo escondido con ellos en el templo de Dios, mientras Atalía gobernaba el país como reina.

fr.L: Et il fut avec eux dans la maison de Dieu, caché, six ans, tandis qu’Athalie régnait sur le pays.
fr.B: Il resta caché avec eux dans la maison de Dieu pendant six ans, tandis qu’Athalie régnait sur le pays.
fr.R: Pendant six ans, Joas est resté caché avec eux dans le temple de Dieu, pendant qu’Athalie gouvernait le pays comme reine.

sw.L: Naye akawa pamoja nao katika nyumba ya Mungu, amejificha, miaka sita, Athalia alipokuwa akitawala juu ya nchi.
sw.B: Alikaa amefichwa pamoja nao katika nyumba ya Mungu miaka sita, wakati Athalia alipotawala juu ya nchi.
sw.R: Kwa miaka sita Yoashi alikaa amefichwa pamoja nao katika hekalu la Mungu, wakati Athalia alipotawala nchi kama malkia.

vi.L: Cậu ở với họ trong nhà của Đức Chúa Trời, ẩn mình sáu năm, trong khi A-tha-li cai trị xứ.
vi.B: Cậu ở ẩn với họ trong nhà của Đức Chúa Trời sáu năm, trong thời gian A-tha-li cai trị xứ.
vi.R: Suốt sáu năm, Giô-ách ở ẩn với họ trong đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời, trong khi A-tha-li làm nữ hoàng cai trị xứ.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그들과 함께 하나님의 집에 숨어서 6년을 지냈고, 아달랴가 그 땅을 다스리고 있었다.
ko.B: 요아스는 그들과 함께 하나님의 집에 숨어서 6년을 지냈다. 그동안 아달랴가 그 땅을 다스렸다.
ko.R: 요아스는 그들과 함께 하나님의 성전에 숨어서 6년 동안 지냈다. 그동안 아달랴가 여왕이 되어 나라를 다스렸다.

pt.L: E ele esteve com eles na casa de Deus, escondido, seis anos, enquanto Atalia reinava sobre a terra.
pt.B: Ele ficou escondido com eles na casa de Deus durante seis anos, enquanto Atalia governava o país.
pt.R: Durante seis anos Joás ficou escondido com eles no templo de Deus, enquanto Atalia governava o país como rainha.

decisions.choice: the same words as 2 Kings 11:3, with "with them" and "the house of God"
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 11:3 has "with her" and "the house of Yahweh". Chronicles has "with them", most likely Jehoshabeath and her husband Jehoiada (verse 11), and "the house of God", the temple in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: Athaliah was reigning: the only woman to rule as monarch in Judah or Israel
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:3: she held the throne for six years, and her reign has no opening or closing formula like those of the kings.

decisions.choice: Joash; temple; as queen (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 11:3: Readable names the child, calls the house of God the temple, and says that Athaliah ruled as queen.

decisions.choice: The wording of 2 Kings 11:3 with "그들과 함께", "하나님의 집" and the years in figures ("6년")
alternatives: "육 년", as the 2 Kings 11 draft has
decisions.reason: Only what the Hebrew changes is changed (m1); years are written in figures in this block.

decisions.choice: com eles; a casa de Deus (L, B), o templo de Deus (R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 11:3 in Portuguese, changed only where Chronicles changes it (m1): "com eles" for Kings' "com ela", and "Deus" for Kings' "SENHOR", so there is no divine_name span here.
